confirmed: Converting measured periodic copies to real supercell atoms drops the third measured atom although it remains physically present. Marker3, distance2 and angle disappear.
reproduction: Load Al FCC, display2a cells, select atoms1 and2 and click visible ghost, edit mode, Make Supercell. All selections used normal UI/pointer events.
rootCause: Selection restore uses the old ghost identity after periodic repeats reset to1; no mapping to generated real atom. Undo must restore original copy identities.
fix: Builder exposes copy identities; conversion maps selected periodic copies to real atoms and snapshots selection context for undo.
